mass_player_id.label: [%key:common::config_entries::mass_player_id::label%]
mass_player_id.description: The Music Assistant player this cast target controls. When you cast from the YouTube Music app to this device, the queue plays on the selected player.

cast_name.label: Cast Device Name
cast_name.description: How this receiver appears in the YouTube Music app's cast device list.

keep_playing_on_disconnect.label: Keep playing when the phone disconnects
keep_playing_on_disconnect.description: Continue playback on the player when the casting phone disconnects or leaves the network. Disable to stop playback on disconnect.

port.label: DIAL port
port.description: TCP port for this instance's DIAL endpoint (allocated automatically).

manifest.description: Makes a Music Assistant player appear as a cast target in the YouTube Music app, so you can hand off the playback queue from your phone to Music Assistant.
